spellbook.finance/limitations: Only the workspace owner may clear an unprotected exact-price lock through delegated MCP. Seller-protected locks refuse delegated removal.
Clearing a lock changes saved configuration. It does not publish, reprice or restore a marketplace listing.

description: Clear one seller SKU's unprotected exact-price lock by exact printing, finish and condition. Seller-protected locks refuse agent removal. Call spellbook_sku_price_controls first to inspect protection; the saved readback confirms a successful clear with a null lock.

condition.description: The exact physical condition for the SKU. Required.

finish.description: The exact finish for the SKU: nf, fo, etched, surge, rh, 1e or 1e-fo. Required.

scryfallId.description: The exact Scryfall printing id. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_sku_exact_price_lock_clear
